testcase.name: @state:overview:loading holds the tide chart while readings load
@state:overview:ready shows the port overview
@state:overview:degraded says which feed is behind
@state:berths:loading keeps the heading while berths load
@state:berths:ready lists the berths booked today
@state:berths:no-berths says none are booked
@state:berths:stale marks the rows out of date
@state:berth:loading keeps the page while the berth loads
@state:berth:ready shows the berth and its draught
@state:berth:not-found answers 404 for an unknown berth
@state:voyage:loading keeps the page while the voyage loads
@state:voyage:ready names the vessel and when it is due
@state:voyage:delayed says how late it is
@state:forecast:loading keeps the heading while the forecast loads
@state:forecast:ready shows the forecast heading
@state:forecast:offline says the gauge is offline
@state:auctions:loading keeps the heading while auctions load
@state:auctions:ready shows the auctions page to the harbourmaster
@state:auctions:closed says no auction is open
@state:audit:loading keeps the heading while the trail loads
@state:audit:ready shows the range in the heading
@state:audit:forbidden answers 404 to a pilot
@state:settings:ready shows the section asked for
@state:berth-grid:idle lists each berth with its vessel
@state:berth-grid:sorted puts the earliest arrival first
@state:berth-grid:unbooked says no berths are booked
@state:berth-grid:stale says the feed paused and keeps the rows
@state:command-palette:closed renders nothing
@state:command-palette:open lists every target
@state:command-palette:no-results says what to try
@state:tide-chart:idle draws the tide as a line
@state:tide-chart:busy holds the space while readings load
@state:tide-chart:offline shows no readings when the gauge is down
@state:vessel-chip:idle names the vessel, then its IMO number
@state:vessel-chip:selected is pressed
